perspectivesAudited.notes: Double-entry IPSAS ledger balanced. Debits = Credits. Append-only audit trail enforced with SYSTEM_ADMIN & User Identity.
HR staff, contracts, attendance, leave, and payroll linked to IPSAS ledger with zero unbudgeted wage liability.
WBS, activities, milestones, and project budgets linked with real-time actual expense vs commitment tracking.
Strategic programs NEB-03 mapped to organizational goals with automated multi-project aggregation.
Strategic objectives, targets, and KPIs calculated directly from source SQL tables without hardcoded metrics.
Segregation of duties, approval lifecycles (DRAFT->APPROVED->POSTED), and reverse journal controls enforced.
Field tasks, assigned teams, beneficiary service logs, and inventory issue vouchers cross-reconciled.
RFQs, vendor evaluations, purchase orders, and commitments bound to cost center budget allocations.
Warehouse stock balance, transfers, distribution vouchers, and asset depreciation accounting verified.
Restricted donor funds isolated with dedicated project commitment allocations and IATI compliance.
Beneficiary eligibility, vulnerability classification, and distribution logs protected with RLS.
Document repository, versioning, policy archives, and immutable record controls verified.
Cross-tenant isolation (0 leaks across subscribers/orgs/branches), RLS policies, and SQL parameterization active.
Gemini AI copilot bound to server-authenticated context with zero hallucinated or unverified metrics.
Executive control dashboards NEB-01 to NEB-15 presenting real-time consolidated KPIs across all branches.
Intuitive Arabic/RTL UI layouts, responsive tables, forms, filters, loading states, and error handling.
